title: Summary for Hurricane Rachel (EP3/EP182026)
summary: ...RACHEL WEAKENS SLIGTHLY AS IT TURNS WESTWARD... As of 2:00 AM MST Fri Oct 02 the center of Rachel was located near 19.4, -110.4 with movement W at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 955 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 115 mph.
